purpose: Execute the already-preregistered JPFM-2F-B3 same-64 OpenCV compatibility replay as deterministic non-overlapping tile shards so GitHub wall-clock limits cannot truncate the measurement chain. This changes execution topology only, not sample selection, source identity, image data, detection configuration, morphology formulas, thresholds, or external-label firewall.

trigger_for_sharding.serial_B3_cancel_boundary: during pass1 -> PSFEx -> pass2 after progress 40/52 distinct tiles
trigger_for_sharding.reason: GitHub job timeout occurred before object-lineage audit, compatibility-patched shape execution, gate evaluation, result writing, validation, upload, or commit. Therefore no scientific B3 outcome existed to inspect before this sharding plan was frozen.

frozen_sample.selection_rule_unchanged: For each frozen structural cluster 0..15: two closest to cluster-median anomaly score plus two highest anomaly score, src_id tie-break.

sharding_contract.assignment: Sort the 52 distinct frozen tile_id strings lexicographically. Assign tile ordinal i to shard i mod 4. All frozen sources from one tile remain in the same shard.
sharding_contract.expected_tile_partition: 13 distinct tiles per shard because 52 is divisible by 4
sharding_contract.aggregate_source_union: Must equal exactly the original 64 frozen src_id values, with 64 unique rows, zero duplicates and zero omissions.

unchanged_measurement_contract: OpenCV compatibility adapter only: convexityDefects ndarray reshaped to (-1,4)

aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.tile_identity: 64/64 source rows must map to reconstructed exact frozen tile_id and all 52 distinct required tiles must be present across shards.
aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.detection_chain: At least 95% of 52 distinct required tiles complete pass1+PSFEx+pass2.
aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.exact_object_id: At least 90% of 64 rows recover exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen object_id.
aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.sky_consistency: At least 90% of exact rows have replay pass2 coordinate <=10 arcsec from frozen S0 coordinate.
aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.pass2_raw_morphology: At least 95% of exact rows have finite FWHM_IMAGE, ELONGATION and SPREAD_MODEL.
aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.shape_execution: At least 90% of exact rows finish compatibility-repaired stage_shape_post with shape_failed=0.
aggregate_gates_identical_to_B3.metric_coverage: Report profile_diff, circularity, shape_defect, circle_deviation and stars_used coverage without threshold tuning.

forbidden_inputs: Blue Book or other human-report labels
external_label_firewall.reason: B3S remains a measurement-validation pilot. A larger/full pixel-morphology sidecar must be built and frozen before any external-label reveal.
